name: Why is proper ventilation important during and after ceiling drywall repair?

mainEntity.name: Why is proper ventilation important during and after ceiling drywall repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper ventilation is crucial during and after ceiling drywall repair for several reasons. It helps expedite the drying time of joint compounds and primers, preventing delays. Good airflow also minimizes dust accumulation from sanding and helps dissipate fumes from materials, improving air quality and worker safety. Adequate ventilation is especially important in the often humid climate of areas like Pacifica to prevent mold growth on newly installed or repaired surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ventilation speeds drying, reduces dust and fumes, and helps prevent mold, especially in humid climates.
